title: Hall of Fame for Great Americans
geometryBasis: Native curved central granite and roof footprint, current exterior photographs and New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission description.
sectionBasis: The college describes a covered Classical colonnade on a substantial granite wall at the site drop-off. The story photographs resolve its paired open columns, walkway, end pediments and plinths.
limitations: The independently mapped central crescent, its roof and its supporting granite podium. Attached library, wings and adjacent buildings are outside scope.
The original walkway level and exact column and plinth profiles are estimates. Sculpture and inscriptions are outside scope.
